summary: Coherus Oncology filed an 8-K announcing a special dividend of contingent value rights (CVRs) to shareholders, distributed pro rata as of a September 30, 2026 record date, with one CVR per share. Each CVR entitles holders to potential cash payments from net proceeds of any sale, license, or royalty related to the company's Legacy BioSim Assets during the CVR term from October 7, 2026 to October 7, 2028. The filing also references a Loan and Security Agreement dated August 12, 2026 with Innovatus Life Sciences Lending Fund. This is a capital return event structuring future asset monetization; watch for asset disposition timing and loan covenant implications.
